name: Harta Djaya Karya Tbk.
summary: PT Harta Djaya Karya Tbk is an Indonesian enterprise specializing in a broad range of construction and interior design solutions. The company's services encompass architectural design and project planning, alongside undertaking both civil engineering and specialized interior construction endeavors. Furthermore, they supply clients with custom-built and ready-made furniture options. Founded in 2012, this firm maintains its principal headquarters in Jakarta, Indonesia, and functions as a subsidiary entity of PT Interra Djaya Karya.
